title: Form 8-K - Carnival Corporation / Carnival plc
summary: Carnival Corporation and Carnival plc held their annual shareholder meetings on April 17, 2026, with all director nominees elected and all board-recommended proposals approved by shareholders. The filing also documents a Court Meeting regarding the proposed dual-listed company (DLC) unification and redomiciliation of Carnival Corporation from Panama to Bermuda.
key_points: All 11 director nominees (including Micky Arison, Josh Weinstein, and Randy Weisenburger) were re-elected to serve until the next annual meetings
Shareholders approved advisory vote on executive compensation with 879,051,088 votes for (88.2% of votes cast)
Deloitte LLP appointed as independent auditor for Carnival plc; Deloitte & Touche LLP ratified for Carnival Corporation
Shareholders authorized Carnival plc to buy back ordinary shares in the open market (1,053,498,983 votes for)
Carnival plc Court Meeting approved the DLC unification and redomiciliation scheme (shareholder majority and 75% value threshold met)
Proxies for 1,205,637,579 shares were received representing the voting base
why_it_matters: This filing documents corporate governance outcomes for one of the world's largest cruise operators. The DLC unification and redomiciliation from Panama to Bermuda represents a structural corporate change but does not constitute a macro catalyst or market structure event. The shareholder votes were overwhelming in favor of all proposals, indicating no material governance risks.
